hours.why: Two plain hours, the same all year, are easy to trust and need no explaining.

day_sound.tune: Keep today's tune, a little higher and with shorter notes, leaving more silence between them.

night_sound.tune: The same five notes, lower and slower, so each bell has room to fade before the next.

finale.day: The run up and one soft chord, as today, and then quiet.
finale.night: A slower run down to one low bell left ringing alone.

avoid: Do not add a second echo or shimmer to every note; one voice per tap is enough.
